# Seed vienna-1912-vertical-slice

## Ferdinand Lechner — short_lived_child

Born 1952.01, 1968.01, age 16. Occupation: none recorded. Education: apprenticeship.

46 committed subject events.

- **1952.01 · 0岁**  `birth` tags: birth ← evt:world-vienna-1912:009643
  Ferdinand Lechner在Leopoldstädter Zinshaus, gemeinsamer Gang出生。Katharina Stein、Hermann Lechner在场；家里现在有4口人。


- **1954.12 · 2岁**  `statistical_infection`
  Ferdinand Lechner在Leopoldstädter Zinshaus, gemeinsamer Gang病倒了，痢疾让身体发热、虚弱，接下来的日子只能卧床。


- **1955.03 · 3岁**  `statistical_illness_worsened`
  Ferdinand Lechner的痢疾没有完全好转，咳嗽和发热又拖了一个月，家里人轮流守着。


- **1955.06 · 3岁**  `statistical_recovery`
  Ferdinand Lechner熬过了这场痢疾，能坐起来喝一点汤，但身体还很虚。

  _effects: mood -0.04; relation kin with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-114_

  _effects: flag +name_change_refused; relation colleague with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-23; knowledge “school records cannot be changed by a nickname”_

  Mitzi Lechner忍到天亮，第二天去药房买了五分钱的棉花，撕成两小团塞在耳里。夜里的进行曲还剩一点闷响，翻个身也就过去了。此后在楼梯间遇见Hermann Weiss只是点头，再没有进过那家的门。
  _effects: cash -0.05 (在药房买棉花塞耳朵); relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-18_

  Mitzi Lechner把通知念给Alois Lechner听，Alois Lechner摇头说是楼梯间那几块新玻璃的账。Mitzi Lechner去楼下杂货铺换开一张五克朗的纸币，回屋一枚一枚摆开数，煤箱底多留了二十赫勒。
  _effects: cash -2 (按月多付两克朗房租); food -1_

- **1929.01 · 25岁** 《丧葬互助会的会费》 `vienna-parish-aid.funeral-society/funeral-society.defer` tags: faith, parish, mutual_aid, poverty, family
  Mitzi Lechner说这个月先欠着，等发工钱补上。Grete Huber在名字旁画了个小圈，写明欠两周，叮嘱别拖过月底，否则要重新排进新会员的等待期。她走时把楼道的门带严，说冷风灌进来煤烧得快。Mitzi Lechner回头数了数抽屉里的零钱，还差三个赫勒。
  _effects: relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-42; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-42_

- **1929.01 · 25岁** 《识字班的第一块石板》 **[composed]** `r13-edu.literacy-class::ctx-vienna-reform-1930::milieu-school/signs-own-name` tags: education, literacy, adult_education, class, belonging, reform, medical, schooling, school, teacher, childhood, adolescence, composed, kernel:r13-edu.literacy-class, context:ctx-vienna-reform-1930, milieu:milieu-school
  Mitzi Lechner在石板上写自己的名字，写到第三遍才把最后一笔收住。Mitzi Hofer把Mitzi Lechner的手按在粉笔上，说慢慢来。放学时，Mitzi Lechner把石板抱在怀里，经过肉铺时第一次看懂招牌上写的是“今日有肝”。那天晚上，Mitzi Lechner在账本封皮上又写了一遍，写到最后一笔时手没有抖。
  _effects: mood 0.07999999999999996; flag +learned_to_sign_name; literacy 0.07_

- **1929.09 · 26岁** 《炉子灭了》 `vienna-women-housework.coal-stove/coal-stove.cold-day` tags: gender, housework, home, labour, family
  孩子放学回来搓着手说冷，Mitzi Lechner把仅有的半捧煤末压进炉底，火苗细得像灯芯。她没接Grete Huber递来的煤块，只说等明天煤店开门。屋里哈气成雾，晚饭的土豆是凉的。
  _effects: relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-42_

- **1930.01 · 26岁** 《夜校的第二排长凳》 **[composed]** `r14-edu.night-class::ctx-vienna-university-1912::milieu-university/too-tired-to-stay` tags: education, adult_learning, literacy, night_school, university, culture, schooling, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:r14-edu.night-class, context:ctx-vienna-university-1912, milieu:milieu-university ← evt:world-vienna-1912:000680
  Mitzi Lechner在夜校撑了六个星期。白天的活儿从早上六点排到晚上七点，坐在长凳上就犯困，Mitzi Hofer叫名字时，Mitzi Lechner猛地站起来，把墨水瓶碰翻了。第二天，Mitzi Lechner没有再出现，课本留在桌肚里，夹着一张没写完的请假条。
  _effects: mood -0.04999999999999993; literacy 0.020000000000000018_

- **1930.02 · 26岁** 《圣文森特会的门铃》 `vienna-parish-aid.rent-box/rent-box.food-only` tags: faith, parish, mutual_aid, poverty, family
  Mitzi Lechner只收下篮里的面包和豆子，把煤袋推回Rosa Huber手里，说房租自己再想办法，请她们给介绍点零工。Rosa Huber把煤放在走廊窗台，说礼拜四后院有人要拆旧木箱，一赫勒一捆，工钱不多但现结。Mitzi Lechner记下门牌，答应一早过去。
  _effects: food 2; flag +seeking_work; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-2_

- **1930.05 · 26岁** 《拔牙的价钱》 `vienna-medical-treatment.toothache/dentist-pull` tags: health, medical, family, money
  诊室在二楼，楼梯间飘着石炭酸味。医生把钳子举到灯下看了看，叫Mitzi Lechner攥紧扶手。Maria Berg站在门边数墙上的价目表：拔牙两克朗五十赫勒，药棉五十赫勒，连消炎水另算。
  _effects: cash -3 (牙医拔牙费用); health 0.05999999999999999; mood -0.030000000000000027_

- **1931.01 · 27岁** 《码头上的旧皮箱》 **[composed]** `r14-edu.return-home::ctx-vienna-university-1912::milieu-university/returned-empty-handed` tags: education, foreign_study, migration, return, university, culture, schooling, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:r14-edu.return-home, context:ctx-vienna-university-1912, milieu:milieu-university ← evt:world-vienna-1912:001981, evt:world-vienna-1912:001909
  Mitzi Lechner回来时，皮箱里没有学位证书，只有一叠药方和几封没寄出的信。船上的医生说是肺病，要静养。Otto Weiss来接站，把Mitzi Lechner的箱子提在手里，轻得不像话。回到租住的屋子，Mitzi Lechner先去看窗台，几年前种的那盆天竺葵已经枯了。药费五克朗，是Otto Weiss垫的。
  _effects: cash -5 (码头上的旧皮箱); flag +returned_empty_handed_

- **1931.01 · 27岁** 《夜里敲接生婆的门》 **[composed]** `r13-civ.midwife::ctx-vienna-reform-1930::milieu-tenement/safe-delivery` tags: health, midwife, birth, neighbor, night, reform, medical, schooling, home, family, poverty, everyday, composed, kernel:r13-civ.midwife, context:ctx-vienna-reform-1930, milieu:milieu-tenement
  Grete Huber把热水、剪刀和一卷粗线摆在桌上，让Mitzi Lechner按住Maria Berg的肩膀。孩子落地时没有哭，Grete Huber倒提着小腿拍了两下，屋里才响起声音。Mitzi Lechner把剪子递过去，手背上全是产妇攥出的红印。
  _effects: cash -3 (夜里敲接生婆的门); flag +attended_safe_delivery; relation friend with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-27_

- **1931.07 · 27岁** 《教授家的周日午餐》 **[composed]** `r2-uni.supervisor-favor::ctx-vienna-reform-1930::milieu-tenement/accepted-assistantship` tags: education, university, patronage, research, housework, reform, medical, schooling, home, family, neighbor, poverty, everyday, composed, kernel:r2-uni.supervisor-favor, context:ctx-vienna-reform-1930, milieu:milieu-tenement
  Mitzi Hofer在周日午餐后把一叠德文校样推到Mitzi Lechner面前，说“先替我看一遍，署不署名以后再说”。Mitzi Lechner翻到第三页，发现自己的脚注已经被并进正文。月底领到第一笔助学金时，Ferdinand Stein在厨房门口洗碗，水声停了很久。
  _effects: cash 4 (教授家的周日午餐); flag +accepted_assistantship; relation colleague with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-30; knowledge “the professor merges student footnotes into his own text”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-60_

- **1931.09 · 28岁** 《一封寄错的信》 `p9-gap-adult-solitude.misdelivered-letter/misdelivered-letter.sugar-jar` tags: adulthood, daily, solitude, ordinary, home, letter
  Mitzi Lechner把信压在厨房的糖罐底下，想着明天再问。三天后糖罐渗了油，信角洇出一片深色，收信人的名字糊了半个。她把信拿到门房那儿，门房说这地址已经退过两回了。
  _effects: social 0.02_

- **1932.01 · 28岁** 《排练室的凳子》 **[composed]** `r13-civ.rehearse-play::ctx-vienna-university-1912::milieu-university/cast-as-understudy` tags: culture, theatre, rehearsal, play, ambition, university, schooling, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:r13-civ.rehearse-play, context:ctx-vienna-university-1912, milieu:milieu-university
  Grete Huber让Mitzi Lechner站在舞台边上看完整场，说先背熟替补的台词。排练室的暖气坏了，演员们穿着大衣念对白。散场时，Grete Huber把一本卷了角的剧本塞给Mitzi Lechner，说明晚还来。
  _effects: flag +cast_as_understudy; role +amateur_actor; social 0.030000000000000006; knowledge “the understudy must know the whole second act by Friday”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-54_

- **1932.10 · 29岁** 《汤厨房的长队》 `vienna-parish-aid.soup-kitchen/soup-kitchen.leave` tags: faith, parish, mutual_aid, poverty, family
  Mitzi Lechner看见熟人排在前面，帽檐压得低低的，便转身拐进旁边的小巷。Friedrich Hofer追出来问怎么不领了，Mitzi Lechner说人太多，改天再来。回到屋里，灶是冷的，早上剩的半个土豆还在盘子里。Mitzi Lechner把它切成片，就着水咽下去。
  _effects: relation acquaintance with person-friedrich-hofer; food 1_

- **1932.11 · 29岁** 《看一间更小的房》 `vienna-housing-move.flat-viewing/flat-viewing-too-damp` tags: housing, home, rent, family, money
  Mitzi Lechner在单间里站了一刻钟，脚底发潮，墙纸底下透出一股霉味。看门人说刷一层石灰就好，Emil Weiss却在门口轻轻咳了一声，提醒这背面没有阳光。Mitzi Lechner把定金收回口袋，谢过看门人，宁可多付三克朗，也不愿把湿气带进夜里。

  市场掌柜把账本翻到空白页，铅笔写上“月底清”，Mitzi Lechner 把拇指按进印泥，红印盖得有点歪。Grete Huber 扛着半袋面粉往回走，袋底漏出的粉在石板路上留下白印。
  _effects: cash -5 (以自家名义赊购面粉); food 3; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-42_

- **1934.01 · 30岁** 《琴谱边上的铅笔字》 **[composed]** `r14-edu.music-teacher-legacy::ctx-vienna-university-1912::milieu-university/inherited-the-scores` tags: education, arts_training, music, legacy, university, culture, schooling, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:r14-edu.music-teacher-legacy, context:ctx-vienna-university-1912, milieu:milieu-university ← evt:world-vienna-1912:001268, evt:world-vienna-1912:000091
  Maria Weiss退休前把一箱琴谱交给Mitzi Lechner，说里面有些是自己抄的，错音不少，别照着弹。Mitzi Lechner翻到一本旧练习曲，页边有铅笔写的指法，还有几处被橡皮擦破的洞。Maria Weiss说这些谱子跟了自己四十年，现在该换个地方落灰了。箱底还有三克朗纸币。
  _effects: cash 3 (琴谱边上的铅笔字); flag +inherited_music_scores; craft 0.04000000000000001; relation colleague with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-3_

- **1934.01 · 30岁** 《工头兜里的粉笔头》 **[composed]** `r13-work.ask-foreman::ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934::milieu-tenement/name-on-the-board` tags: work, hiring, foreman, favour, queue, vienna, urban, crisis, war, repression, industrial, medical, home, family, neighbor, poverty, everyday, composed, kernel:r13-work.ask-foreman, context:ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934, milieu:milieu-tenement
  Mitzi Hofer说这个月不添人，让Mitzi Lechner把名字写在门房的纸板上。纸板上已经有四十多个名字，最上面一行被雨泡花了。Mitzi Lechner写得很小，挤在一个“王”字旁边，Mitzi Hofer看了一眼说，回去等吧，别天天来。
  _effects: cash -1 (工头兜里的粉笔头); flag +work13_name_on_the_gate_board; knowledge “the gate board already holds more than forty names”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-78_

- **1934.03 · 30岁** 《家庭教师的口音》 **[composed]** `r2-leisure.governess-lesson::ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934::milieu-tenement/pupil-defended-her` tags: domestic_service, governess, education, class, language, vienna, urban, crisis, war, repression, industrial, medical, home, family, neighbor, poverty, everyday, composed, kernel:r2-leisure.governess-lesson, context:ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934, milieu:milieu-tenement
  Katharina Weiss把默写本藏在背后，说错误是她自己写的，跟老师无关。Leopoldstädter Volksschule伸手去夺，本子撕成两半；Katharina Weiss哭着说，老师教的是法语，不是妈妈的规矩。Mitzi Lechner站在窗边，第一次没有替自己辩解。
  _effects: mood 0.06000000000000005; flag +pupil_defended_governess; role +governess; relation friend with person:evt:world-vienna-1912:000928:child; knowledge “the pupil will defend her teacher against her mother”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-85_

- **1934.09 · 31岁** 《门锁换了，涨租单贴在门上》 `major-crisis.rent-increase/pay-the-increase` tags: crisis, housing, rent, eviction, family, poverty
  房东没有露面，只让看门人Grete Huber把补款单塞进门缝：每月要多十四克朗，先交十八克朗（本月十四加四克朗手续费）才肯谈续租。Mitzi Lechner把准备买冬煤的钱数了两遍，还是把钱交了，收据上写的是“自愿捐助”。Grete Huber低声说，不签的人已经有两家搬走了，楼下的煤价牌又换了数字。
  _effects: cash -18 (advance payment demanded with the rent increase); relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-42; flag +rent_increase_accepted_

- **1935.01 · 31岁** 《活动影戏的第十本胶片》 **[composed]** `kernel-culture.film-screening::ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934::milieu-university/civic-film-censored` tags: culture, film, cinema, censorship, reform, vienna, urban, crisis, war, repression, industrial, medical, university, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:kernel-culture.film-screening, context:ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934, milieu:milieu-university
  审查官在放映前剪掉了两段，Otto Lechner把剪下的胶片放在桌上。她问能不能接回去，Otto Lechner说“接了也过不了”；她还是接了一段，观众看到画面跳了一下，没有人出声。散场后，Otto Lechner把剪下的胶片塞进她的包里。
  _effects: flag +film_censored; relation colleague with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-72; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-78; cash -2 (被剪后补租胶片的费用); reputation 0.03; knowledge “被剪掉的胶片接回去也过不了审查，画面会跳一下”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-72_

- **1935.07 · 31岁** 《救济厨房的长队》 `p9-gap-adult-unemployed.soup-kitchen/soup-got-scoop` tags: adulthood, unemployment, casual_labour, poverty, daily, relief, food, church
  教堂后院的铁锅冒着白汽，排队的人把各种罐子捧在胸前。Gustav Berg穿着灰围裙一勺一勺地分，轮到Mitzi Lechner时锅底已经露出来，勺子刮出响声，还是刮了半勺倒进罐里。
  _effects: food 1; health 0.03_

- **1935.07 · 31岁** 《组织留下的名单》 `vienna-social-movement.aftermath/testify` tags: development, social_movement, organization, consequence
  Mitzi Lechner在警察局走廊里等了一下午，最后把知道的地址写在纸上。回家时，楼道里有人把门关得很轻；Mitzi Lechner知道他们听见了脚步声。
  _effects: membership -org-wednesday-psychological-society; reputation -0.05000000000000002_

- **1936.01 · 32岁** 《星期天去卡伦山的路》 `p9-social-daily-culture.sunday-hill/p9-social-daily-culture.sunday-hill.first-winery` tags: daily, culture, leisure, cafe, music, walk, task, task:daily
  Mitzi Lechner和Alois Lechner在第一个酒棚就坐下了，要了一壶新酒，Friedrich Hofer摸出一副磨损的纸牌。三人打到下午，太阳偏西也没再往上爬；Mitzi Lechner输了几个铜板，连酒带牌局一共一克朗五十赫勒，倒赢回一肚子笑话。回程的电车上，Mitzi Lechner靠着窗，酒意上来，差点坐过站。
  _effects: cash -1.5 (酒棚的新酒和牌局输的铜板); relation friend with person-alois-lechner; relation acquaintance with person-friedrich-hofer; mood 0.040000000000000036_

- **1936.02 · 32岁** 《门楣上的红绳》 **[composed]** `r14-spec.neighborhood-curse::ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934::milieu-university/the-iron-box` tags: neighborhood, curse, rumor, fear, community, vienna, urban, crisis, war, repression, industrial, medical, university, student, research, writing, teacher, composed, kernel:r14-spec.neighborhood-curse, context:ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934, milieu:milieu-university
  Mitzi Lechner顺着红绳找到Friedrich Hofer家的后院，土里埋着一只铁盒，盒里是Mitzi Lechner家丢了两年的门牌和一缕头发。Friedrich Hofer站在门口，说红绳不是咒人，是提醒自己别忘了那笔旧账。Alois Lechner在墙外听见，转身就走。Mitzi Lechner把铁盒盖上，手心里全是土。
  _effects: mood -0.06000000000000005; flag +spec14_curse_revenge; relation rival with person-alois-lechner; relation rival with person-friedrich-hofer; knowledge “the neighbour kept the missing house plaque buried in the yard”_

- **1936.04 · 32岁** 《清样上的红铅笔》 **[composed]** `r14-hist.censored-writer::ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934::milieu-university/signed-the-loyalty-declaration` tags: censorship, writing, repression, press, vienna, urban, crisis, war, industrial, medical, university, student, research, teacher, composed, kernel:r14-hist.censored-writer, context:ctx-vienna-authoritarian-1934, milieu:milieu-university
  Helene Moser把一份“忠于国家”的声明放在Mitzi Lechner面前，说不签就不能继续写戏剧评论。声明只有一页，下面空着三行，留给“曾用笔名”和“外国资助”。Mitzi Lechner逐行填完，在“外国资助”一栏写“无”。Franz Kral看完，把声明收进档案袋，说下一期可以照常发稿；Mitzi Lechner回家后把旧笔名从稿纸上划掉。
  _effects: cash 2 (清样上的红铅笔); reputation -0.08000000000000002; flag +signed_loyalty_declaration; knowledge “the censorship office keeps a file of signed declarations”; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-95_

  Mitzi Lechner在清理旧档案时发现原始记录少了三页，缺口正好落在最漂亮的曲线上。Mitzi Hofer说那三页是草稿，不用留；Mitzi Lechner把复印件寄给Anton Lechner 2。报道登出那天，Mitzi Hofer在办公室里把整盒档案倒在地上，让人帮他找那三页。

## Maria 2 — additional_life

Born 1920.01, still living, age 52. Occupation: none recorded. Education: primary.

194 committed subject events.

- **1920.01 · 0岁**  `birth` tags: birth ← evt:world-vienna-1912:000760
  Maria 2在Kral-Wohnung, Leopoldstadt出生。Berta Moser、Josef Bauer 2在场；家里现在有4口人。


- **1921.01 · 1岁** 《一天里的几顿奶》 `vienna-life-infant-feeding/fed-bread-pap` tags: infancy, food, household
  奶水不够，Berta Moser把黑面包掰碎泡在热水里，加一点糖喂给Maria 2。孩子夜里哭得更久，肚子鼓胀。
  _effects: condition +stomach ache; cash -1 (bread and sugar)_

- **1926.01 · 6岁** 《第一次去国民学校》 `vienna-life-school-enrolment/enrolled` tags: childhood, school, fees
  Berta Moser带Maria 2到Leopoldstädter Volksschule报名。Berta Huber在名册上写下孩子的姓名和出生月份，收了两克朗书本费，让孩子第二天带一块石板来。
  _effects: education primary; cash -2 (school books（其中2克朗记入债务）); role +pupil; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-23; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-23_

- **1926.01 · 6岁** 《看住最小的弟妹》 `p9-gap-childhood-chores.mind-sibling/sibling-falls-at-well` tags: childhood, household, chores, school, task, daily, sibling, care, task:family
  Helene 2的鞋掉在井台边，Maria 2先去捡鞋，回头才看见Helene 2摔在湿石头上。Emil Weiss用围裙裹住Helene 2，血从膝盖渗出来。Berta Moser夜里把Maria 2叫到灶台前，数落了很久，最后把锅里剩下的半勺汤倒回大锅，只给Maria 2留了半碗。
  _effects: mood -0.06; relation kin with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-17_

- **1927.01 · 7岁** 《石板、点名与冻僵的手指》 `vienna-life-school-day/punished` tags: childhood, school, hunger
  放学路上，Maria 2把手揣在口袋里，碰一下就疼。回到家门口，Maria 2先把手背在身后，等Berta Moser转身才敢看；那道红印到晚上还没有消。
  _effects: condition +bruised palm; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-23_

- **1927.01 · 7岁** 《弄到一块能写字的石板》 `p9-gap-childhood-chores.school-slate/slate-borrowed-from-teacher` tags: childhood, household, chores, school, task, daily, supplies, education, task:education
  “借你可以，拿劳动换。”Berta Huber把旧石板推到桌沿，又指了指墙角的灰桶。Maria 2先去后院倒灰，风把炉灰吹回来，落在睫毛上。回来时Berta Huber已经用粉笔在石板背面写了一个“借”字，说擦掉那天就是还石板的日子。
  _effects: literacy 0.03; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-23_

- **1927.09 · 7岁** 《半张床的界线》 `p9-childhood-household.half-bed/chalk-line` tags: childhood, family, household, home, siblings, illness, neighbors
  粉笔是Maria 2在讲台底下捡的，短得只剩指甲盖长。Maria 2趴在床板上，从这头划到那头，线歪了一点，又用唾沫擦掉重划。夜里Grete 2的膝盖越过线，Maria 2用胳膊肘顶回去，两个人在黑暗里推来推去，被子滑到地上。
  _effects: relation kin with person:evt:world-vienna-1912:001032:child_

- **1928.01 · 8岁** 《帮邻居晾一院子的床单》 `p9-gap-childhood-chores.laundry-help/laundry-three-heller` tags: childhood, household, chores, school, task, daily, laundry, work, neighbor, task:daily
  “拽平，别留褶。”Berta Moser在绳子那头喊。Maria 2踮着脚把床单拉直，碱水把指缝泡得发白。收工时天已经黑了，Berta Moser数了三赫勒，又在围裙上擦干手才递过来。Maria 2把钱塞进袜筒，回家路上一直攥着，虎口的裂口沾了汗，火辣辣地疼。
  _effects: cash 0.03 (帮邻居晾床单挣的三赫勒); relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-17; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-61_

- **1928.07 · 8岁** 《报亭后的秘密画片》 `vienna-childhood-friends.secret-kiosk/traded-for-picture` tags: childhood, social, school, street
  “就一口。”Maria 2把糖块掰开，换了一张火车头。Berta Moser在报亭窗口看着，等糖纸落地，才走出来。画片被扣在柜台上，扫帚递到Maria 2手里。Maria 2扫完半条后巷，Berta Moser用围裙擦了擦画片，还回来时角上多了一道折痕。
  _effects: mood -0.03; relation acquaintance with person-materialized-world-vienna-1912-17_

- **1928.08 · 8岁** 《节拍器卡在第三拍》 **[composed]** `r2-leisure.piano-lesson::ctx-vienna-reform-1930::milieu-tenement/played-through-the-metronome` tags: leisure, piano, lesson, discipline, ambition, reform, medical, schooling, home, family, neighbor, poverty, everyday, composed, kernel:r2-leisure.piano-lesson, context:ctx-vienna-reform-1930, milieu:milieu-tenement
  Maria 2没有管节拍器，自己数着拍子把这一小节弹完。Berta Huber的铅笔停在半空，等最后一个音落下才敲桌面，说节奏错了，但音乐对了。Josef Bauer 2在隔壁听见，推门问是不是可以考音乐学院。Grete 2从门缝里学了一句，走调走得比Maria 2还准。
